summary: Dispatched to implement Phase 3 (task-number references) and Phase 5 (suppression audit) only, per explicit delegation scope. Phase 3 (REOPENED by a prior exclusion audit) is now fully re-closed as COMPLETED: fixed 47 of the reopen's ~50 sites across 7 files (Minimal/Completeness.lean, Temporal/Tableau/Completeness.lean, Nested/Context.lean, Intuitionistic/Completeness.lean, Nested/Rules.lean, CS5Completeness.lean, Nested/Soundness.lean, Scheme.lean), each committed individually after a scoped rebuild plus downstream-importer rebuilds. Every fix replaced a task/phase citation with a durable anchor already present in the same sentence (a lemma name, a filename, or a descriptive title) -- never deleting the surrounding technical explanation. 20 repo-wide sites remain, all individually verified and accounted for: LoopChecking.lean (3, held back per the explicit ordering constraint -- Modal/Tableau refactor coordination, not attempted); 5 sites inside direct quotations of the governing plan's own task-list text (rewriting would misquote the source, same disposition as the prior cycle's verbatim-quote exclusions); the 4-site 'Recommendation for continuation' block in Scheme.lean (task-management metadata whose correct disposition is relocation to specs/, not in-place rewriting -- an unchanged finding, retained as an exclusion rather than acted on since relocation is a bigger structural change than a citation rewrite); and 8 sites (TemporalConservativity.lean, DiegoEmbedding.lean, Labelled/Soundness.lean) confirmed false positives or genuinely unanchorable by a prior cycle, unchanged. Phase 5 (suppression audit) advanced by 2 files: Separation/TemporalClosure.lean (5 blanket suppressions -> 0: 3 categories vestigial, style.longLine fixed mechanically, linter.flexible across 10 declarations narrowed to 10 declaration-scoped set_option lines) and BXCanonical/Chronicle/PointInsertion/Since.lean (5 -> 0: 3 categories vestigial, style.longLine fixed mechanically, linter.flexible across 2 declarations narrowed to 2 declaration-scoped set_option lines). Suppression-audit progress: 173 -> 183 sites cumulative (27 files fully processed). Ratchet re-baselined in each file's own commit (266 -> 258 blanket suppressions repo-wide). A new safety finding was caught and recorded: a declaration-scoped `set_option ... in` line must precede the doc comment, not follow it -- the reverse order is a hard parse error, caught by the mandatory rebuild-before-commit discipline before anything broken was staged; a repo-wide scan confirmed zero remaining instances of the broken ordering. Also discovered and flagged (not fixed, out of this dispatch's Phase 3/5 scope): the `--wfail --iofail` gate now reports 12 warnings instead of the documented 5 -- 7 new non-sorry warnings in 3 files (SoundnessStep.lean, Normalization/Termination.lean, CutElimination.lean) this dispatch never touched, traced to an unrelated upstream-sync merge that landed while the task was paused. Phase 7's two prior-cycle blockers were explicitly NOT re-investigated per the delegation instruction and are carried forward unchanged below.

This needs either a dedicated follow-up cycle to fix the 3 affected files, or an explicit decision to reopen Phase 1 (currently marked COMPLETED; its own closure criterion is now falsified by this regression).

decisions_made: Fixed every Phase 3 reopen site that had a durable anchor already present in the same sentence, per the reopen's own corrected test ('is a durable anchor available?', not 'does the referenced artifact exist yet?').

Left 5 sites untouched where rewriting would misquote a verbatim quotation of the governing plan's own text -- rewriting inside a direct quote misrepresents the source, distinct from a citation that can be freely reworded.

Left Scheme.lean's 4-site 'Recommendation for continuation' block untouched -- it is task-management metadata whose correct home is specs/, and relocating it is a bigger structural change than this dispatch's citation-rewrite scope; retained the prior cycle's exclusion rather than attempting relocation unprompted.
Held LoopChecking.lean's 3 sites back entirely, per the plan's own explicit ordering constraint (Modal/Tableau refactor coordination) reiterated in this dispatch's HARD CONSTRAINTS.

For Phase 5, applied the established 'remove all suppressions, rebuild, categorize, fix mechanical, narrow the rest to declaration scope' method on the two smallest remaining local-only count-5 files, verified local-only via git cat-file before starting each.

Caught a parse-error regression from my own edit (set_option-after-doc-comment ordering) via the mandatory rebuild-before-commit step, fixed it, then verified with a repo-wide scan that no other instance of the same mistake exists anywhere in Cslib/**.

Discovered a 5-vs-12-warning baseline discrepancy while establishing the pre-work baseline; investigated it (checked which files were affected, checked those files were untouched by any commit in this dispatch, checked recent git log for the actual cause) rather than either silently absorbing it into this cycle's numbers or silently ignoring it.
Did not re-investigate Phase 7's two carried-forward blockers, per the explicit delegation instruction that they are settled and awaiting a human decision, not further investigation.
dead_ends: None. All edits landed cleanly; the one mid-cycle parse error (set_option/doc-comment ordering in Since.lean) was caught before commit by the mandatory rebuild step and fixed within the same working session, not left as a dead end.
